baseline_evidence: https://github.com/openpacketcore/openpacketcore-sdk/issues/1207 records unchanged main 3bd4459f8 under CPU and disk contention: the Durable batch detector (#923) failed 6/10 and the all-voters-cold detector (#1207) failed 4/10. These are the real-I/O members of that family, not separate measured failure rates for every listed test.
